facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations for FY2024-25 was INR 24,064 crore, up 9% year on year.
EBITDA for FY2024-25 was INR 2,656 crore, approximately 11% higher year on year.
Profit after tax for FY2024-25 was INR 1,941 crore, approximately 13% higher year on year.
The company reported record phosphatic fertilizer sales of 4 million tons, with plants operating close to full capacity.
Crop Protection and bioproducts revenue reached INR 2,637 crore, growing 7% year on year.
Capital expenditure in FY2024-25 was INR 830 crore, 61% higher than the previous year, primarily for backward integration and Kakinada capacity expansion.
A 0.75 million ton brownfield fertilizer capacity expansion at Kakinada was described as expected within two years.
facts.time_language: within two years from the FY2024-25 report

facts.statement: Sulphuric acid and phosphoric acid projects were described as progressing toward commissioning by early 2026, intended to make fertilizer manufacturing sites backward integrated and reduce import dependence.
The company identifies climate change or monsoon failure in target markets as a risk to turnover and profitability.
The disclosed mitigations for climate or monsoon failure include market-oriented product liquidation and climate-monitoring tools for product placement.

india_kharif_2026.relevance: The issuer explicitly identifies monsoon failure as a turnover and profitability risk, establishing a possible company exposure channel.
india_kharif_2026.reason: The report establishes general exposure but does not quantify current Kharif-2026 sensitivity by crop, state, product, revenue, or margin.
india_kharif_2026.permitted_claim: Coromandel has disclosed that monsoon failure can affect turnover and profitability; current event-specific impact remains unproven.

non_authority_statement: Extracted issuer statements only; not a Signal, Catalyst, Opportunity, recommendation, position, or trade.
